Ella points to blank blue/yellow list sheets resting on table; Max raises two fingers. Only these two visible in crop; prepared soup bowls rest down.

Bottom left S47: Maya seated FAR-right long side with garden window behind; Dan NEAR-left foreground at diagonal opposite, face shown in side profile. She holds one new blank planning card and he raises one finger, playful expressions. No fruit yet.
Bottom right S48: WIDE elevated view from same master camera side, whole room and entire table, ALL SIX ONCE. Ella coral braids FAR LEFT and Maya plum FAR RIGHT, both visible faces with window behind. Leo orange at LEFT END in profile. Nina teal at RIGHT END in profile. Dan blue at NEAR LEFT, Max green at NEAR RIGHT seen from behind/three-quarter, both looking inward. Six chairs/six people, no front-facing lineup. Prepared salad/soup in bowls only, blank blue/yellow lists flat beside serving dishes. No bags/basket/raw market produce, no extra people. Warm quiet contented smiles, no synchronized speech.
Only shot labels S45 S46 S47 S48. No dialogue text. Preserve clothes, bodies and faces. Rectangular table geometry and exact fixed seats override desire to show all faces. Static storyboard art.
